title: Hypothesis on Emergence and Consciousness Mechanism of Large Language Models Based on Reciprocal Unit Coupling, Critical Dynamics and Local Entropy Reduction (Full Version V5)
summary: The emergence of high-order capabilities in large language models (LLMs) constitutes a core challenge in the fundamental theory of artificial intelligence. The mainstream scaling laws can only describe statistical phenomena of model performance growing with scale and cannot explain the dynamical causal mechanism behind emergent behaviors. This paper constructs a unified hypothesis grounded in complex systems theory: nonlinear reciprocal coupling forms among units inside the Transformer; during training, gradient descent acts as the global self-organizing driving force, modulating unit…
